title: Retire the generated queue and dependency pages
goal: backlog-queue.mjs and backlog-dependencies.mjs validate without writing pages; projects delete the pages
acceptance: Both tools validate (cycles, missing or broken links, duplicate Queue order, unknown priority/effort/cue) and write nothing; `--check` keeps its meaning
An old generated page still present fails `--check` with the instruction to delete it
Page renderers and their tests go; CI steps run on the tool's presence, not the page's
The template deletes its own two pages and links
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Released in v5.5.0 after PR #120 (CI) and review-fix PR #121 (CI 43077690845) with independent review; baseline 1 focused day(s). No actual recorded per step: the steps were built together; the whole feature took about 1.5 agent hours including review.
